resources.string: Tava LiXiangQi gaṇanā sajjā. Tvaṃ niyame sikkhasi vā puna kīḷituṃ āgacchasi vā, tava āgamanena mayaṃ tuṭṭhā.
Mukhapaṭṭhato kīḷaṃ ārabhāhi. Paṭhamaṃ sukhena kīḷituṃ gaṇakayantaṃ paṭipakkhaṃ katvā kīḷāhi.
Bhayāni passituṃ jayakarāni gamanāni ca vindituṃ sikkhāhi. Mā turitaṃ karohi: rājassa bhayaṃ, gahaṇaṃ, paṭipakkhassa anāgatagamanañca cintāhi.
Attano paṭṭhe saṅkhittena attānaṃ vaṇṇehi, yathā aññe kīḷakā taṃ jāneyyuṃ.
Ayaṃ tava %s paribhogaṃ paṭicca pesitā sevāpaṇṇā.
